_about: Average rates used ONLY when no PWD SOR / Standard Data rate exists for a take-off line. Shown as 'Estimated' and editable by the user. Basis: CPWD Delhi Schedule of Rates 2023 (national reference schedule, already stored in the database) where an equivalent item exists, otherwise an indicative Chennai market average (2025-26, from public rate guides, checked 2026-10-09). Update these when official rates become available.

excavation.basis: CPWD DSR 2023 item 2.8.1 — earthwork in excavation in foundation trenches (mechanical/manual)

anti_termite.basis: Market average ≈ ₹6/sq ft pre-constructional soil treatment (IS 6313), coastal high-risk band ₹5–7/sq ft

fw_found.basis: CPWD DSR 2023 item 5.9.1 — centering & shuttering, foundations / footings / column bases

fw_slab.basis: CPWD DSR 2023 item 5.9.3 — centering & shuttering, suspended floors / roofs / landings

fw_beam.basis: CPWD DSR 2023 item 5.9.5 — centering & shuttering, lintels / beams / plinth beams

fw_col.basis: CPWD DSR 2023 item 5.9.6 — centering & shuttering, columns / pillars

granite.basis: CPWD DSR 2023 item 11.56.2 — polished granite stone, laid

putty.basis: CPWD DSR 2023 item 13.80 — white cement based putty, 1 mm, on plastered walls

door_frame.basis: CPWD DSR 2023 item 26.86.1 — factory-made WPC door frame (chowkhat)
